create_regmatch_solver: create a RegretMatching approximate Nash solver with optimism and discount options
init_solver_vars: initialize solver parameters with number of strategies per player and number of players
compute_regmatch_gradients: compute regret-matching gradients and exploitability estimates from payoff matrices
update_regret_matching_params: update cumulative regret and strategy distribution using regret-matching update rule
record_aux_errors: record auxiliary error norms from gradient tuples for monitoring solver convergence
